profile.headline: Software Engineer at MDLIVE, Inc.
profile.summary: As a problem solver, I’m constantly challenging myself and I never stop learning. My experience has prepared me to be logical, organized, and a team player.

positions.title: Software Engineer
QA Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: My role was to ensure the quality of the MDLIVE platform and functionalities and pay attention to the details in order to maintain the high quality of the platform, through tests that include: Manual tests, verifying frontend (UI/UX) and backend (logic and database) functionalities; Automation tests - developing scripts using Rspec, Capybara, and FactoryBot for unit tests; Testing APIs with Postman; and running the regression tests automated in Reflect tool before each release. While in this position, I’d been mentored by senior developers, and under their guidance, I started my path as a software engineer.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
PROJECTS:

# Next Tech Trivia:
 
An interactive game for Google Cloud Next '20: OnAir'. Our amazing team developed a dynamic app so the user can enjoy an awesome experience! If the user answers 4-5 questions correctly, the user can spin the wheel for a prize!

Technology used: JavaScript, MERN, Stack, Canvas APIs: Gitfit as rewards, SendGrid to send emails to users, and Cloudinary to store images.

# SmartAgenda:

A web application for business owners to keep track of client information as well as appointments that are displayed on their calendar. The project was developed as a Wyncode final Project. This project is under continuous improvement for the next releases.

# Easy Weather:
A React app that pulls weather information and displays tips about the weather condition of the day. Just type the name of the city and voilà! The project was developed as a Wyncode MidTerm Project.

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description: Member of Permanent Bidding and Procurement Commission, acting as an auctioneer on public biddings, dealing with procurement procedures and administrative member of Information Technology Contracts Comission.

positions.title: Bank Teller
positions.description: Customer Service, providing account services to customers by receiving deposits and loan payments; bill payments, cashing checks; issuing savings withdrawals; doing transfer bank to bank (TED/DOC), doing judicial deposits etc.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Working as an assistant in the Public Relations department, my position required organizing events, being responsible for logistics, including setting up booths at trade shows and replacing promotional material; responsible for controlling the amount of promotional materials in the warehouse; promotion of MPA events through email marketing. I was also responsible for receiving and sending documents through internal system.

company.name: Ministério da Pesca e Aquicultura (MPA), Brazil
